pose: A multi-dinosaur interaction shot. The colossal REF_TYRANNOSAURUS_REX_ADULT is waddling away toward the rear of the stage with its back turned to the other dinosaurs[cite: 1]. In the midground, the PACK of REF_TROODON_ADULTs (at least three adults) cautiously approaches the food[cite: 1]. They exhibit intelligent, alert postures as they prepare to dine[cite: 1]. One Troodon is beginning to feed on a stylized raw steak that lies near the Orodromeus remains[cite: 1]. The Orodromeus carcass is only partially consumed; the back, stomach, and forelegs remain intact and look normal, ensuring food remains for later[cite: 1].

render_parameters.negative_constraints: No graphic violence, strictly toy-like 'X' eye effect on carcass, no text, no borders, no extraneous people or IDs, strictly two arms per dinosaur, no negative space[cite: 1]
